# BYZ scope. The chronicle (gen_chronicle.py row aeg: a hook, notes part 三). Void: the line is over and none of its
# events came, the Maona never formed, Phokaia did not fall by W2, and the family never held Lesbos. Ended: the line
# is over. Under way: from the first window (1346.6), or once something of the line has happened.
oe_aeg_none = {
    NOT = { var:oe_aeg_st_1 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_aeg_st_2 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_aeg_st_3 ?= 1 }
    NOT = { var:oe_aeg_st_8 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_aeg_st_9 ?= 1 }
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aeg_maona }
    NOT = { global_var:oe_aeg_ws_2 ?= 1 }

}
